ext":"古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":26,"text":"小破书","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":28,"text":"古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":30,"text":"古书","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":39,"text":"秘典","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":46,"text":"秘典","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":58,"text":"秘典","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":78,"text":"黑色古书","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"r_star","mentions":[{"paragraph":33,"text":"金色十字星","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":36,"text":"金色十字星","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":38,"text":"守护之星","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":41,"text":"金色十字星","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":42,"text":"金色十字星","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":46,"text":"金色十字星","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":46,"text":"守护之星","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":49,"text":"十字星","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":57,"text":"十字星","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":60,"text":"十字星","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":63,"text":"十字星","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":73,"text":"金色十字星","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"r_voice","mentions":[{"paragraph":37,"text":"陌生的声音","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":65,"text":"声音","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"r_task","mentions":[{"paragraph":39,"text":"每日任务","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":40,"text":"每日任务","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":43,"text":"每日任务","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":77,"text":"每日任务","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":82,"text":"每日任务1","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":87,"text":"日常任务","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"r_official_mg","mentions":[{"paragraph":83,"text":"正牌魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":85,"text":"正牌魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"r_villain_mg","mentions":[{"paragraph":8,"text":"反派魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":29,"text":"反派魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":74,"text":"反派魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":75,"text":"反派魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":81,"text":"魔法少女（反派）","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"r_beastfolk","mentions":[{"paragraph":18,"text":"兽人","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":19,"text":"兽人","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":19,"text":"猫娘狐娘","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":20,"text":"兽人","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"r_human","mentions":[{"paragraph":18,"text":"人类","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":20,"text":"人类","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"r_association","mentions":[{"paragraph":20,"text":"兽人互助协会","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"r_rongcheng","mentions":[{"paragraph":20,"text":"蓉城","occurrence":0,"name":false},{"paragraph":83,"text":"蓉城","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"r_medical","mentions":[{"paragraph":20,"text":"医学院","occurrence":0,"name":false}]},{"id":"r_divine_stone","mentions":[{"paragraph":84,"text":"神典石","occurrence":0,"name":false}]}],"disclosures":[{"id":"d1","from":1,"to":1,"text":"第2章标题为《反派的日常就是找茬》。","channel":"author","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d2","from":2,"to":2,"text":"作者严正声明：本书出场角色均已满18岁，不存在任何未成年人。","channel":"author","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d3","from":6,"to":6,"text":"苏天晴吐掉牙膏泡沫，放下猫猫水杯与牙刷，双手撑住洗手池，抬头看向镜子里的金毛狐狐。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_fox"]},{"id":"d4","from":7,"to":7,"text":"镜中的狐狐五官精致可爱，毛发柔顺肌肤光滑，能从宽松睡衣领口看到浅浅河谷，眼眸不安而惊讶，带着狐人天生的魅意。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox","r_body"]},{"id":"d5","from":8,"to":8,"text":"苏天晴认为，抛开听起来很离谱的反派魔法少女身份不谈，这副身体的容貌绝妙。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_villain_mg","r_body"]},{"id":"d6","from":9,"to":9,"text":"苏天晴觉得这具身体的每个细节都满足自己曾经的幻想，让人想细细品尝。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_body","r_su"]},{"id":"d7","from":10,"to":10,"text":"苏天晴说了一声“舔”。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d8","from":12,"to":12,"text":"苏天晴觉得美妙，认为“爷”太可爱了。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d9","from":13,"to":13,"text":"苏天晴认为无论面庞还是身材都和自己曾经想象的完美匹配。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_body","r_su"]},{"id":"d10","from":14,"to":14,"text":"苏天晴认为萝莉本身就是最美妙的奖励，不需要别的奖励。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_fox"]},{"id":"d11","from":15,"to":15,"text":"苏天晴心里念着“可爱的小狐狸”。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_fox"]},{"id":"d12","from":17,"to":17,"text":"苏天晴与镜中自己对视后，察觉自己举动像变态，脸红并收敛，开始审视身体中残留的记忆。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"d13","from":18,"to":18,"text":"据残留记忆，这副身体的原主人也叫苏天晴；这个世界与苏天晴曾经的世界相差无几，但人类与兽人共存。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_orig_su","r_body","r_human","r_beastfolk"]},{"id":"d14","from":19,"to":19,"text":"这里所说的兽人指猫娘、狐娘，不是地里长出来的大菌子绿皮。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_beastfolk"]},{"id":"d15","from":20,"to":20,"text":"据残留记忆，兽人与人类名义上共存，但兽人数量远不及人类；原主苏天晴从小孤独长大，模样可爱但社恐孤僻，受兽人互助协会资助考上蓉城最好的医学院，临近开学时染上兽人流感，熬夜中突发暴发性心肌炎。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_beastfolk","r_human","r_orig_su","r_association","r_rongcheng","r_medical"]},{"id":"d16","from":21,"to":21,"text":"苏天晴发现原主的死法和自己一模一样。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su","r_orig_su"]},{"id":"d17","from":23,"to":23,"text":"苏天晴想到这感觉胸口幻痛，伸手去揉。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d18","from":25,"to":25,"text":"简单洗漱后，苏天晴穿着不合脚的大拖鞋走到客厅，躺上沙发，从茶几上拿起那本曾跟自己说话的古书。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_book"]},{"id":"d19","from":26,"to":26,"text":"苏天晴对着古书问：“喂？小破书你在吗？”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_book"]},{"id":"d20","from":28,"to":28,"text":"古书没有像刚才那样开口说话，仿佛床头那件事没发生过。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_book"]},{"id":"d21","from":29,"to":29,"text":"苏天晴揣测，所谓的反派魔法少女可能根本不存在。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_villain_mg"]},{"id":"d22","from":30,"to":30,"text":"苏天晴抱着侥幸举起古书，翻开扉页。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_book"]},{"id":"d23","from":33,"to":33,"text":"一枚金色十字星从书里掉出，砸在毫无防备的苏天晴脸上。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_star","r_book","r_su"]},{"id":"d24","from":35,"to":35,"text":"狐狐喊疼，惊呼鼻血冒出来了。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_fox","about":["r_fox"]},{"id":"d25","from":36,"to":36,"text":"金毛狐狐怪叫着去抓纸巾，没有注意到金色十字星沾上鼻血，血在微光中融入十字星消失。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox","r_star"]},{"id":"d26","from":37,"to":37,"text":"一道陌生的声音在狐狐脑子里响起。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_voice","r_fox"]},{"id":"d27","from":38,"to":38,"text":"系统提示：守护之星激活。","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_star"]},{"id":"d28","from":39,"to":39,"text":"系统提示：秘典序章已完成，开启每日任务。","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_book","r_task"]},{"id":"d29","from":40,"to":40,"text":"苏天晴对“每日任务”和“守护之星”感到惊讶，觉得系统来真的。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_task","r_star"]},{"id":"d30","from":41,"to":41,"text":"狐狐正在塞纸巾、拍冷水，愣了一下，回头看向沙发上放出微光的金色十字星，几秒后才把它重新拿在手里。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox","r_star"]},{"id":"d31","from":42,"to":42,"text":"苏天晴观察金色十字星，认为其材质不明、做工精致、手感扎实，不像塑料玩具，猜测这是魔法少女必备的变身道具。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_star"]},{"id":"d32","from":43,"to":43,"text":"苏天晴疑惑每日任务要怎么查看。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_task"]},{"id":"d33","from":44,"to":44,"text":"苏天晴猜测是否要像网络小说一样默念“系统”，或者有特别解锁密码。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_task"]},{"id":"d34","from":46,"to":46,"text":"苏天晴把玩金色十字星，比起莫名其妙的秘典，更对这枚“守护之星”感兴趣。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_star","r_book"]},{"id":"d35","from":47,"to":47,"text":"苏天晴想象魔法少女变身、穿华丽洋装在城市穿梭飞行与怪人战斗，并想到这具身体的原主人也梦想过这种场面。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_body","r_orig_su"]},{"id":"d36","from":48,"to":48,"text":"苏天晴心里问要不要试试看。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_star"]},{"id":"d37","from":49,"to":49,"text":"狐狐尾巴左右摇摆，试探性地把十字星捏在手里，轻声喊出羞耻的词。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox","r_star"]},{"id":"d38","from":50,"to":50,"text":"狐狐喊：“变……变身！”","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_fox","about":["r_star"]},{"id":"d39","from":51,"to":51,"text":"十字星没有反应。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_star"]},{"id":"d40","from":52,"to":52,"text":"苏天晴疑惑变身是否不是这样喊，或需要加前缀。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_star"]},{"id":"d41","from":53,"to":56,"text":"狐狐尝试喊“魔法少女变身！”、“henshin！”、“光啊！”、“盖亚！！”。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"r_fox","about":["r_fox"]},{"id":"d42","from":57,"to":57,"text":"狐狐嗓子快喊哑，把能想到的变身词都喊了一遍，十字星仍无动静。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox","r_star"]},{"id":"d43","from":58,"to":58,"text":"苏天晴抱怨秘典不给新手指引，至少该教怎么变身。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_book"]},{"id":"d44","from":59,"to":59,"text":"苏天晴认为这是破玩意、没意思。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_star"]},{"id":"d45","from":60,"to":60,"text":"狐狐气鼓鼓瘫在沙发上，把十字星拿到面前端详。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox","r_star"]},{"id":"d46","from":61,"to":61,"text":"苏天晴发现十字星上面没写字，疑惑到底怎么变身。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_star"]},{"id":"d47","from":62,"to":62,"text":"苏天晴猜测要敲一下、搓动某个位置，或别的办法。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"r_su","about":["r_star"]},{"id":"d48","from":63,"to":63,"text":"苏天晴盯着十字星中间能容纳手指的凹陷，试探着把拇指摁进去。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_star","r_su"]},{"id":"d49","from":64,"to":64,"text":"光芒顷刻间笼罩客厅。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d50","from":65,"to":65,"text":"白光一瞬消失，随后身体各处传来轻盈触感，脑海中响起莫名声音。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_body","r_voice"]},{"id":"d51","from":66,"to":66,"text":"系统提示：初次变身已完成。","channel":"in-world-system","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":[]},{"id":"d52","from":67,"to":67,"text":"苏天晴茫然惊叫：“什、什么东西！？”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_voice"]},{"id":"d53","from":68,"to":68,"text":"苏天晴意识到原来是触摸屏，自己还以为是声控。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_star"]},{"id":"d54","from":69,"to":69,"text":"苏天晴站起身转一圈，感受身体周围流淌的力量，走到卧室落地镜前看去。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"d55","from":70,"to":70,"text":"有一瞬间，苏天晴想抱着自己狂舔。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d56","from":71,"to":72,"text":"苏天晴觉得除了可爱，依然是可爱。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d57","from":73,"to":73,"text":"变身后穿着过膝白袜、金色短款洋装，胸前领口缀着闪亮金色十字星，身后有毛茸茸大尾巴，头上两只耳朵，华丽灿烂。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_star","r_fox"]},{"id":"d58","from":74,"to":74,"text":"苏天晴看到变身后的模样后，对反派魔法少女这个强行安排的最后抵触也消失了。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_villain_mg","r_su"]},{"id":"d59","from":75,"to":75,"text":"苏天晴决定：不就是反派魔法少女吗，我就当给你看。","channel":"thought","mode":"plan","holder":"r_su","about":["r_villain_mg"]},{"id":"d60","from":76,"to":76,"text":"镜中的狐狐眼神坚定，在胸前握紧拳头。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_fox"]},{"id":"d61","from":77,"to":77,"text":"苏天晴决定接下来查看每日任务是怎么回事。","channel":"thought","mode":"plan","holder":"r_su","about":["r_task"]},{"id":"d62","from":78,"to":78,"text":"苏天晴维持变身状态走回客厅，拿起沙发上不会说话的黑色古书，小心翻开，怕里面再蹦出东西砸脸。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_book"]},{"id":"d63","from":79,"to":79,"text":"这次没有东西蹦出，书里只是普通笔记书页，但第一页浮现几行文字。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_book"]},{"id":"d64","from":80,"to":80,"text":"古书页面显示：【苏天晴】。","channel":"document","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_book","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d65","from":81,"to":81,"text":"古书页面显示：【魔法少女（反派）】。","channel":"document","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_book","about":["r_villain_mg"]},{"id":"d66","from":82,"to":82,"text":"古书页面显示：【每日任务1：找茬魔法少女】。","channel":"document","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_book","about":["r_task"]},{"id":"d67","from":83,"to":83,"text":"古书页面显示：【正牌魔法少女在蓉城风生水起已经够久了，给她一点颜色瞧瞧】。","channel":"document","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_book","about":["r_official_mg","r_rongcheng"]},{"id":"d68","from":84,"to":84,"text":"古书页面显示：【奖励：100神典石】。","channel":"document","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_book","about":["r_divine_stone"]},{"id":"d69","from":85,"to":85,"text":"苏天晴心里问：找茬正牌魔法少女？","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_official_mg"]},{"id":"d70","from":86,"to":86,"text":"苏天晴看到这几个字，微微一怔。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su","r_task"]},{"id":"d71","from":87,"to":87,"text":"苏天晴觉得这个看似简单的日常任务好像真不好做。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_task"]}],"beats":[{"id":"b1","from":1,"to":1,"gist":"章节标题：反派的日常就是找茬。","mode":"paratext","about":[]},{"id":"b2","from":2,"to":3,"gist":"作者声明本书出场角色均已满18岁且无未成年人；随后为分隔线。","mode":"paratext","about":[]},{"id":"b3","from":4,"to":5,"gist":"洗漱时传来水声和吐掉牙膏泡沫的声音。","mode":"narrative","about":[]},{"id":"b4","from":6,"to":9,"gist":"苏天晴洗漱后照镜子，欣赏金毛狐狐的外貌，并认为抛开反派魔法少女身份不谈，这副身体绝妙。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su","r_fox","r_body","r_villain_mg"]},{"id":"b5","from":10,"to":16,"gist":"苏天晴舔镜中的自己，沉醉于狐狐的可爱与美妙。","mode":"reflection","about":["r_su","r_fox"]},{"id":"b6","from":17,"to":23,"gist":"苏天晴自觉像变态后收敛，审视残留记忆，得知原主同名、世界人类与兽人共存、原主身世与死因，并因想到死亡而胸口幻痛。","mode":"exposition","about":["r_su","r_body","r_orig_su","r_human","r_beastfolk","r_association","r_rongcheng","r_medical"]},{"id":"b7","from":24,"to":30,"gist":"苏天晴走到客厅拿古书并呼唤小破书，古书沉默，她怀疑反派魔法少女不存在，翻开扉页。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su","r_book","r_villain_mg"]},{"id":"b8","from":31,"to":36,"gist":"金色十字星从书里掉出砸中苏天晴的脸，她流鼻血，血在微光中融入十字星消失。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su","r_book","r_star","r_fox"]},{"id":"b9","from":37,"to":40,"gist":"陌生声音在狐狐脑中响起，系统提示守护之星激活、秘典序章完成并开启每日任务；苏天晴惊讶。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_voice","r_fox","r_star","r_book","r_task","r_su"]},{"id":"b10","from":41,"to":43,"gist":"狐狐查看发光的金色十字星，猜测它是变身道具，并思考如何查看每日任务。","mode":"reflection","about":["r_fox","r_star","r_task","r_su"]},{"id":"b11","from":44,"to":48,"gist":"苏天晴琢磨查看任务的方法，更对守护之星感兴趣，幻想魔法少女变身，并心动想试试。","mode":"reflection","about":["r_su","r_star","r_book","r_body","r_orig_su"]},{"id":"b12","from":49,"to":59,"gist":"狐狐尝试各种变身词却毫无反应，随后抱怨秘典不给新手指引。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_fox","r_star","r_su","r_book"]},{"id":"b13","from":60,"to":63,"gist":"狐狐端详十字星，发现中间凹陷，苏天晴试探着把拇指摁进去。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_fox","r_star","r_su"]},{"id":"b14","from":64,"to":68,"gist":"白光笼罩又消失，系统提示初次变身完成，苏天晴惊叫并意识到十字星是触摸屏。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_body","r_voice","r_su","r_star"]},{"id":"b15","from":69,"to":76,"gist":"苏天晴在落地镜前查看变身后的洋装与狐狐外貌，最后抵触消失，决心当好反派魔法少女，镜中狐狐握拳。","mode":"reflection","about":["r_su","r_body","r_star","r_fox","r_villain_mg"]},{"id":"b16","from":77,"to":79,"gist":"苏天晴维持变身回客厅，翻开黑色古书，第一页浮现出文字。","mode":"narrative","about":["r_su","r_task","r_book"]},{"id":"b17","from":80,"to":84,"gist":"古书页面显示角色为苏天晴、身份为魔法少女（反派），每日任务1是找茬正牌魔法少女，奖励100神典石。","mode":"exposition","about":["r_su","r_villain_mg","r_task","r_official_mg","r_rongcheng","r_divine_stone","r_book"]},{"id":"b18","from":85,"to":87,"gist":"苏天晴看到任务内容，觉得这个看似简单的日常任务不好做。","mode":"reflection","about":["r_su","r_official_mg","r_task"]}]}

一声“舔”。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d8","from":12,"to":12,"text":"苏天晴觉得美妙，认为“爷”太可爱了。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d9","from":13,"to":13,"text":"苏天晴认为无论面庞还是身材都和自己曾经想象的完美匹配。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_body","r_su"]},{"id":"d10","from":14,"to":14,"text":"苏天晴认为萝莉本身就是最美妙的奖励，不需要别的奖励。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_fox"]},{"id":"d11","from":15,"to":15,"text":"苏天晴心里念着“可爱的小狐狸”。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_fox"]},{"id":"d12","from":17,"to":17,"text":"苏天晴与镜中自己对视后，察觉自己举动像变态，脸红并收敛，开始审视身体中残留的记忆。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su","r_body"]},{"id":"d13","from":18,"to":18,"text":"据残留记忆，这副身体的原主人也叫苏天晴；这个世界与苏天晴曾经的世界相差无几，但人类与兽人共存。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_orig_su","r_body","r_human","r_beastfolk"]},{"id":"d14","from":19,"to":19,"text":"这里所说的兽人指猫娘、狐娘，不是地里长出来的大菌子绿皮。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_beastfolk"]},{"id":"d15","from":20,"to":20,"text":"据残留记忆，兽人与人类名义上共存，但兽人数量远不及人类；原主苏天晴从小孤独长大，模样可爱但社恐孤僻，受兽人互助协会资助考上蓉城最好的医学院，临近开学时染上兽人流感，熬夜中突发暴发性心肌炎。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_beastfolk","r_human","r_orig_su","r_association","r_rongcheng","r_medical"]},{"id":"d16","from":21,"to":21,"text":"苏天晴发现原主的死法和自己一模一样。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su","r_orig_su"]},{"id":"d17","from":23,"to":23,"text":"苏天晴想到这感觉胸口幻痛，伸手去揉。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"r_su","about":["r_su"]},{"id":"d18","from":25,"to":25,"text":"简单洗漱后，苏天晴穿着不合脚的大拖鞋走到客厅，躺上沙发，从茶几上拿起那本曾跟自己说话的古书。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["r_su","r_book"]},{"id":"d19","from":26,"to":26,"text":"苏天晴对着古书问：“喂？小破书你在吗？”","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"r_su","about":["r_book"]},{"id":"d20"
